name: Persepolis
heritage: World Heritage Site; Iranian National Heritage
type: archaeological site; cultural property; architectural landmark; ancient city
text: Persepolis was the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire (c. 550–330 BC). It is situated in the plains of Marvdasht, encircled by the southern Zagros Mountains, Fars province of Iran.

depictions.name: Persepolis
depictions.text: Persepolis is the location in the Prince of Persia series.
